About.title: More years of life
About.lead: Simply live healthier, day by day.
whyItems: No pills or supplements — just better everyday decisions.
Easy to set up and use — whether you're just starting or looking for new ways to improve.
Science-based, built for your daily life — no complicated routines or special equipment.
About.forYouText: Working on improving your health? We make getting started and sticking with it simple. Our goal is for you to feel empowered, supported, and confident building the habits that really count.
About.nextStepText: Start today with a small change — and watch your daily decisions add up to a healthier, longer life. We're here to guide you, encourage you, and celebrate every step forward.
About.missionText: We want to help you live longer and healthier — starting with the habits you build every day. Our app is designed to make healthy living simple and clear, so you know exactly which steps to take to feel better and keep progressing without overwhelm.
